verdict: Paid channels are dark; local search visibility dropped sharply this week.
narrative: No paid ads ran on Meta or Google during the last 28 days, meaning no leads were generated through those channels this period. Your Google Business Profile was the only active source of inbound interest, producing 36 actions (2 calls, 23 direction requests, 11 website clicks) across 22 days — but that activity fell 82% in the last 7 days compared to the 7 days before, and search clicks dropped 75% over the same span. Both signals contracted at the same time, pointing to a real pullback in local search visibility rather than a one-day fluctuation. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore lead flow, and the Google Business Profile is being reviewed to identify and address what's driving the visibility decline.
